rule: WAITING is line-specific and never means mission IDLE or DONE. Blocked work registers its dependency and the mission continues with the highest-priority non-blocked item.

items.objective: Reconcile current feature-branch state with source-main mission evidence and current Git/PR/CI state.
Require persistent event-backed mutation lineage for material control-plane writers.
Extend deterministic replay across all material event-backed control-plane producer classes.
Close repository-side coverage gaps while preserving the platform human-authority boundary.
Demonstrate concurrent mission execution without lost state, duplicate claims or broken event chains.
Execute persisted control-plane adversarial scenarios and prevent NOT_EXECUTED from becoming PASS.
Migrate CAS projection writes onto canonical event lineage and deterministic replay.
Implement response-coupling lineage without inventing decision/action identities.
Verify and harden AlertSystem -> ResponseCouplingSink -> response ledger and determine the remaining decision-producer semantic gap.
items.semantic_boundary: The runtime accepts only explicitly identified real decision/action identities; it does not fabricate a decision producer. External decision identity remains an explicit integration input.

reconciliation.basis: Current-head CI passed compileall, CAS audit, event replay audit, 132 unit tests and authoritative bootstrap; interrupted-persistence and concurrency paths were included in the verified suite.
